map.皮褶法和体脂秤哪个准？: Which is more accurate, the skinfold method or a body fat scale?
map.皮褶法误差约 ±3–4%，依赖测量技术；BIA 体脂秤受水分、餐后、运动波动大。: The skinfold method has an error of about ±3-4% and depends on technique, while a BIA body fat scale swings a lot with hydration, after eating and after exercise. Measure the same person at the same sites at the same time (such as first thing in the morning, fasting); the long-term trend is worth more than any single absolute value.
map.相比体脂秤 BIA，皮褶法在固定测量人/部位/时机下重复性更好，适合长期自测趋势: Compared with a BIA scale, the skinfold method repeats better when the measurer, sites and timing are fixed, which suits tracking your own long-term trend.
